tasks.taskDescription:
You were venturing into the wilderness of Planet X to a storage shed to fetch some supplies. The shed door locked behind you, and your key appears too rusted to work in the lock. You remember one of the other colonists mentioning that one of the chemicals in the shed is a rust remover, but unfortunately the chemicals you see are all unlabelled.You need to figure out which is a rust remover, and use it to remove the rust from the key.  Then, use the key to open the shed door, and make your way back to the colony. You have no means of communication with the other colonists, and must figure this out on your own. 
Some helpful notes: 
1. The rusted key is in the shed. 
2. The shed door is locked, and will only open using a non-rusted key. 
3. You can add chemicals to the jar. Just use a chemical dispenser on the jar to add chemicals to the jar. 
4. The solution is only a single chemical, and should not require mixing chemicals. If you add multiple chemicals into the same jar, they will automatically mix, having different properties than any single chemical. 
5. Placing the rusted key into the jar will automatically apply the chemical in that jar to the key.  If the chemical is correct, the rust will be removed, though it may up to 2 steps for this to happen. 
6. If you need to clean the jar of chemicals to try a new chemical, use the bottle washer on the jar. 
7. When you have successfully derusted the key and opened the door, please leave the shed.

steps.title: rotate direction · list accessible objects · pickup object
steps.code:
import primitive_api as api

# Let's rotate north at (22, 12) and see if we can pick up the bottle cleaner (51739) or use it on the table.
api.rotate_direction("north")
acc = api.list_accessible_objects()
print("At (22,12) facing north, acc:", acc)

# Can we pick up bottle cleaner (51739) or dispensers? Let's test picking up bottle cleaner.
res = api.pickup_object(51739)
print("Pickup bottle cleaner:", res["observation_after"]["lastActionMessage"] if "observation_after" in res else res.get("error"))
print("Inventory now:", api.list_inventory())

# Move west to (21, 12) where Dispenser D (55934) is to the north
api.move_direction("west")
api.rotate_direction("north")
acc = api.list_accessible_objects()
print("At (21,12) facing north, acc:", acc)

# Use Dispenser D (55934) on jar (35632)
res = api.use_object(55934, 35632)
print("Use Dispenser D on jar:", res["observation_after"]["lastActionMessage"] if "observation_after" in res else res)
print("Inventory after Dispenser D:", api.list_inventory())

# Put rusted key (33120) in jar (35632)
res = api.put_object(33120, 35632)
print("Put key in jar:", res["observation_after"]["lastActionMessage"] if "observation_after" in res else res)
print("Inventory after put key in jar:", api.list_inventory())
print("Accessible after put key in jar:", api.list_accessible_objects())

# Wait 2 steps and check key/jar description
for i in range(2):
    api.wait()
    print(f"After wait {i+1}, inv:", api.list_inventory(), "acc:", api.list_accessible_objects())

steps.title: pickup object · rotate direction · use object
steps.code:
import primitive_api as api

# Pick up key (33120) and jar (35632) from table at (21, 12)
api.pickup_object(33120)
api.pickup_object(35632)

# Helper to clean jar at (22, 12)
def clean_jar_from(current_x):
    while current_x < 22:
        api.move_direction("east")
        current_x += 1
    api.rotate_direction("north")
    res = api.use_object(51739, 35632)
    print("Clean jar:", res.get("observation_after", {}).get("lastActionMessage"), res.get("error"))
    return current_x

# Helper to test dispenser at target_x
def test_dispenser(current_x, target_x, dispenser_uuid, table_uuid, label):
    while current_x > target_x:
        api.move_direction("west")
        current_x -= 1
    while current_x < target_x:
        api.move_direction("east")
        current_x += 1
    api.rotate_direction("north")
    # Put jar on table
    api.put_object(35632, table_uuid)
    # Dispense chemical into jar
    res = api.use_object(dispenser_uuid, 35632)
    print(f"Dispense {label}:", res.get("observation_after", {}).get("lastActionMessage"))
    # Put key into jar
    res = api.put_object(33120, 35632)
    print(f"Put key in jar ({label}):", res.get("observation_after", {}).get("lastActionMessage"))
    # Wait 2 steps
    for i in range(2):
        api.wait()
    acc = api.list_accessible_objects()
    key_obj = [o for o in acc if o["uuid"] == 33120][0]
    print(f"After {label}, key:", key_obj)
    # Pick up key and jar
    api.pickup_object(33120)
    api.pickup_object(35632)
    return current_x, key_obj["name"]

cx = 21
cx = clean_jar_from(cx)

# Test C at x=20 (dispenser 8549, table 58937)
cx, key_name = test_dispenser(cx, 20, 8549, 58937, "C")
if "rusted" in key_name and "not rusted" not in key_name:
    cx = clean_jar_from(cx)
    # Test B at x=19 (dispenser 57736, table 31029)
    cx, key_name = test_dispenser(cx, 19, 57736, 31029, "B")
if "rusted" in key_name and "not rusted" not in key_name:
    cx = clean_jar_from(cx)
    # Test A at x=18 (dispenser 21559, table 58743)
    cx, key_name = test_dispenser(cx, 18, 21559, 58743, "A")

print("Final key state in inventory:", api.list_inventory())
print("Check success:", api.check_success())

6. If you need to clean the jar of chemicals to try a new chemical, use the bottle washer on the jar. 
7. When you have successfully derusted the key and opened the door, please leave the shed.

# Check door state
acc = api.list_accessible_objects()
print("Accessible after use key:", acc)
door_objs = [o for o in acc if o["uuid"] == 18573]
if door_objs and "closed" in door_objs[0]["description"]:
    res = api.open_object(18573)
    print("Open door:", res.get("observation_after", {}).get("lastActionMessage"), res.get("error"))

# Move south to leave the shed
for step in range(3):
    res = api.move_direction("south")
    print(f"Move south {step+1}:", res.get("observation_after", {}).get("lastActionMessage"), api.check_success())
    if api.check_success().get("completed"):
        break

api.write_evidence("rust_remover_chemical", "Substance B")
print("Final check_success:", api.check_success())

You remember one of the other colonists mentioning that one of the chemicals in the shed is a rust remover, but unfortunately the chemicals you see are all unlabelled.You need to figure out which is a rust remover, and use it to remove the rust from the key.  Then, use the key to open the shed door, and make your way back to the colony. You have no means of communication with the other colonists, and must figure this out on your own.
